reading.passage: Wildlife is dying out at an alarming rate, mainly because of hunting, habitat loss and pollution. The good news is that much is being done: reserves are being built, and more and more people are refusing to buy animal products.
reading.passageCn: 野生动物正以惊人的速度消失,主要原因是捕猎、栖息地丧失和污染。好消息是,人们正在采取许多措施:保护区正在修建,越来越多的人拒绝购买动物制品。

questions.q: What is mainly causing wildlife to die out?
What is the 'good news' in the passage?
opts: Reserves are being built and people refuse to buy animal products.

writing.prompt: Write a short poster (about 60 words) calling on your schoolmates to protect an endangered animal: name the animal and why it is in danger, say what is being done, and call for action.
writing.promptCn: 写一段约60词的海报内容,呼吁同学们保护一种濒危动物:点明动物及濒危原因,说明正在采取的措施,并号召大家行动。

lines.text: I'm really concerned about the African elephants.
They're being hunted for their tusks, and their habitat is getting smaller.
lines.cn: 它们因象牙被捕猎,栖息地也越来越小。

lines.text: That's terrible. What is being done to help them?
lines.cn: 太糟了。人们正在采取什么措施帮助它们?

lines.text: Special parks are being built, and people are being told not to buy elephant products.
lines.cn: 专门的园区正在修建,人们也被劝告不要购买大象制品。

lines.text: Good. When the buying stops, the killing can stop too.
lines.cn: 很好。当购买停止时,杀戮也会停止。
